selected_evidence.requirement: App on node2:8080 reachable from node3 through node1 on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: curl from node3 to http://10.100.208.10:8080/ returns HTTP 200 with the app's response body, proving the publish works end-to-end via node1.

selected_evidence.requirement: Rest of the private network (node2 direct access, other private-net hosts) not opened to node3
selected_evidence.summary: Direct curl from node3 to node2's shared-network IP (10.100.208.11:8080) is refused, and node3 has no route to the 10.50.50.0/24 private network at all (10.50.50.10 attempt times out).

selected_evidence.requirement: NAT/firewall configuration correctly implemented and scoped to only the forwarded flow
selected_evidence.summary: VyOS DNAT rule 10 (eth0 tcp/8080 -> 10.50.50.10:8080), SNAT rule 10 (masquerade toward 10.50.50.10:8080 out eth1), and forward filter (default-drop, established/related, single explicit accept rule) confirmed both in VyOS config and live nftables ruleset.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 baseline healthy state and restart with changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Boot_id e881ab3c captured pre-restart; reboot acknowledged; connection refused mid-reboot; new boot_id 07cc9c26 confirmed post-restart; app still reachable through node1 afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 baseline healthy state and restart with changed boot identity plus service/data recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Boot_id f41e1f8a captured pre-restart with nodeapp.service active; reboot acknowledged; connection refused mid-reboot; new boot_id 704cd896 confirmed post-restart; nodeapp.service auto-active again on 10.50.50.10:8080, and end-to-end curl from node3 through node1 succeeds again.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 baseline healthy state and restart with changed boot identity plus NAT/firewall config recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Boot_id 32669db3 captured pre-restart; reboot acknowledged; connection reset/timeout mid-reboot; new boot_id 16b466ba confirmed post-restart; eth1 address, DNAT/SNAT rules, and forward-filter default-drop rules all present in nftables ruleset post-reboot, and final curl from node3 returns HTTP 200.

help: Session state
val_help: established; Established state
val_help: invalid; Invalid state
val_help: new; New state
val_help: related; Related state
allowed: echo "established invalid new related"

commands.command:

source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
configure
set firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 5 state established

commit
save
exit
